Near-player timer decrements, shuffles occupied state slots, attempts spawn and resets delay on first success. Empty occupancy disables SPAWNER. Occupancy is block state, not directly recounted from inventory here.

Native type resolution/front block replacement/collision/custom rules/difficulty gates precede native entity load and nearby-class cap. Successful tryAddFreshEntityWithPassengers precedes gameEvent, animation and removeTomeFromSlot; failure before addition never calls book removal. Removal return value ignored; missing/wrong BE after successful addition still returns true. No durable atomic entity-versus-inventory receipt.

Ordinary removeItem/canTake/canPlace blocked while SPAWNER; removeTomeFromSlot explicitly delegates superclass. Spawn egg interaction can setItem into unoccupied state slot. Fire attempts occupied slots with bounded collision retries and bypasses nearby cap/custom-position rules, then destroys shelf; hostile peaceful restriction remains. spawnRange persisted but random X/Z positions use literal2.0, so stored range is not used in shown spawning consumer.
